_readme: Azlan's real field work, in his own numbers. Nothing here is guessed: a null number is simply not shown. A photo appears on the About page only when its file exists, it has width and height, and consent is true (the people in it agreed to it being published). Process photos first with: npm run photo:prepare -- <file>
programme: Community Service Project, G. Pulla Reddy Engineering College, Kurnool
